# KNX lighting — Crox Farmhouse

<!-- Generated by `node tools/knx/run.mjs --write-docs` from src/homes/crox-farmhouse/knx/. Do not edit by hand. -->

The KNX installation is described as an ETS-style project (`CROX_KNX_PROJECT`,
`src/homes/crox-farmhouse/knx/`) and run by the generic bus emulator
(`src/integrations/knx/emulator.ts`). Group-address and device lists:
[knx-group-addresses.csv](knx-group-addresses.csv) · [knx-devices.csv](knx-devices.csv).

## Switch and presence behaviour (every zone)

| Gesture on a Corston toggle gang | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Short flick ▲ | Next stored scene of that gang's zone (wraps; from off/night wakes into scene 1) |
| Short flick ▼ | Previous scene (from off/night wakes into the last scene) |
| Hold ▲ (≥ 600 ms) | Full brightness — every zone circuit 100 % |
| Hold ▼ (≥ 600 ms) | **Night mode** — zone night levels (3–5 %) when dark (< lux threshold), off in daylight |

Presence: each detector holds presence for 60 s after the last movement (demo override 12 s via
`setPresenceHoldTimeOverride`). A zone in night mode switches **fully off** when all its detectors are vacant and the
hold time has elapsed since night mode was entered; presence in an **off** zone after dark restores night mode.
Pressing any switch counts as presence in the room it is mounted in. Switched-only channels (5A lamp relays,
PIR relays, garage battens) treat any level > 0 as 100 %.

## GA plan

Main groups: 0 central · 1 house ground · 2 house first · 3 outbuildings · 4 HVAC · 5 exterior.
Middle groups: 1 switch (1.001) · 2 brightness (5.001) · 3 status (5.001) · 4 sensors (presence 1.018 at x/4/20+n, lux 9.004)
· 5 gates & media · 6 zone control (sub 4n scene 17.001, 4n+1 night 1.001, 4n+2 full/off 1.001, 4n+3 dim 3.007)
· 7 zone feedback (sub 2n scene status, 2n+1 on/off status), n = zone ordinal in its main group.

## Walkthrough presence

`MotionPresenceBridge` (`src/integrations/knx/motion-presence.ts`) maps a first-person foot position to the
detectors whose coverage (XZ polygon + height band) contains it and calls `reportPresence(pa)` on the emulator.
Wiring (app layer):

```ts
const bridge = new MotionPresenceBridge(knx, knx.getPresenceDetectors());
createTwinRuntime({ ..., onWalkthroughPresence: (pos) => bridge.update(pos) });
```
